items.html: And we will not now elaborate on the order of their ascent, but we will mention briefly the last and greatest ascent of them all, which is at the afternoon prayer of the Sabbath — for then they would ascend to the utmost ascent. And it is that the world of Atzilut would rise to its first place, which is in the place of Adam Kadmon of all the ancients, whose explanation is mentioned by us at great length, and all existence would return to its first root.
